question: Who was named as the new Chief Secretary of Delhi in April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naresh Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Naresh Kumar:-**

 
 
• **​He is a 1987-batch IAS officer of the AGMUT cadre. **
 
• He has previously served as the Chief Secretary of Arunachal Pradesh and as the Additional Chief Secretary of Delhi.
 
• **Naresh Kumar was named as the new Chief Secretary of Delhi in April 2022.**
 
• He is known for his expertise in public finance and development administration.
 
• He is also a strong advocate for good governance and transparency.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keshav Prasad Maurya:-**

 
 
• **He is the Deputy Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, India. **
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He was born on May 7, 1969, in Sirathu, Kaushambi district.
 
• He graduated in Hindi Literature from Allahabad University.
 
 
 
• **Amit Singh:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who is the current Deputy Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. **
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and represents the Sirathu constituency in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly.
 
• He is considered to be a prominent leader of the OBC community in Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Sanjay Prasad:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian bureaucrat and the current Principal Secretary to the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Yogi Adityanath. **
 
• He is considered to be one of the most powerful bureaucrats in the state.
